description: This file contains the implementation of a silo configurator for Orleans streaming tests, including classes for configuring event generation within a streaming test environment, such as EventGeneratorStreamingSilo, TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig, and TimeBoundEventGenerator.

classes.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo
classes.description: Configures Orleans silo to generate streaming events with specified parameters, including stream type, count, and timing.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for time-bounded event stream generation, specifying namespace, number of streams, payload type, start and end times.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator
classes.description: Implements the logic to generate streaming events within a specified time window, managing stream IDs and event sequencing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up the Orleans silo builder with memory storage, streaming options, and stream generator configuration based on provided parameters.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration data, creating stream IDs and payload object.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Generates a batch of streaming events if within the configured time window, otherwise returns false.
